en.bdb: Who may be called a Sikh of the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa gursikh mil gur saranee aaiaa|

en.bdb: The life of that gurmukh is fortunate whom meeting some Sikh of the Guru has come to the shelter of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes kar safal moorat gur dharasan paiaa|

en.bdb: He bows before primeval Purusa (God) and becomes blessed after having the sight of such a Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਕਰਿ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paradhakhanaa dda(n)ddaut kar masatak charan kaval gur laiaa|

en.bdb: After circumambulation he bows on the lotus feet of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur purakh dhiaal hoi vaahiguroo sach ma(n)trr sunaiaa|

en.bdb: Becoming kind, the Guru recites true mantra Vaheguru for him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਰਾਸਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਦੇ ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach raas raharaas dhe pairee(n) pai jag pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: The Sikh with his capital of devotion falls at the feet of Guru and the whole world bows at his feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaam karodh virodh har lobh moh aha(n)kaar tajaiaa|

en.bdb: God (the Guru) eradicates his lust, anger and resistance and gets his greed, infatuation and ego erased.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam naam dhaan isanaan dhiraRaiaa|

en.bdb: Instead, the Guru makes him practise truth, contentment, dharma, name, charity and ablution.
Adopting the teachings of the Guru, the individual is called a Sikh of the Guru.
